principles: AI output is analysis, not authority.
Every substantive proposition should retain source provenance.
The system must distinguish quoted source material, extracted facts, researcher interpretation, empirical findings, and model-generated analysis.
Unknown or disputed facts must remain unknown or disputed rather than being completed by inference.
Legal conclusions should identify the governing jurisdiction and date-sensitive authority.
The system should expose citations and supporting passages where technically possible.
Models should not fabricate cases, statutes, legislative history, statistics, procedural events, or quotations.
Comparative analysis must preserve jurisdictional differences rather than treating similar labels as equivalent law.
